Reg. No. GR/RNP/GOA/32 RNI No. GOAENG/2002/6410
Panaji, 15th January, 2009 (Pausa 25, 1930)
SERIES II No. 42
Notification
No. 19/DP/G.EL/TALEIGAO/08/88
In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-sections (1), (5) and (6) of Section 7 of the Goa Panchayat Raj Act,
1994 (Goa Act 14 of 1994) (hereinafter called the “said Act”), the Government of Goa hereby determines the number
of members and wards reserved for Women and Other Backward Classes and Scheduled Tribes as specified in column
(2), (3), (4) and (5) respectively of the schedule appended hereto, in respect of Village Panchayat constituted under
Section 3 of the said Act and specified in the corresponding entry in column No. (1) of the said schedule, for North
Goa District.
This Notification shall have effect for the purpose of ensuing General Elections to the Village Panchayat.

Panaji, 8th January, 2009.

5. Ms. Grace Kare, Goa Animal Welfare Trust for Salcete, Sanguem and Quepem Blocks.
